proposed_delta.call_change: Replace only the Python interpreter descriptor call with that new helper. Full original interpreter bytes/SHA/7-field identity remain bound to the request, actual product tuple, capture ledger and rechecks.
proposed_delta.minimal_helper: One observer-local parse_python_interpreter(body, linkage) verifies exact bytes and full length64..64MiB, forms actual header_view=body[:8MiB], calls unchanged frozen linkage.parse_elf_product(header_view), and returns its descriptors plus captured_bytes, captured_sha256=SHA256(fullbody), header_view_bytes, header_view_sha256=SHA256(actualview). Existing exact-request full interpreter hash check on the same body remains required before build/runtime; returned captured_sha256 must equal that exact declared full SHA.
necessary_checks_inherited: Exact bytes, ELF magic, class1/2 and data encoding1/2, ident/version1; struct widths/endianness read from declared ELF descriptors, without host architecture or syscall guesses.
ET_EXEC/ET_DYN, ELF header size52/64 and program header size32/56; 1..128 program headers, phoff>=ehsize and complete table inside actual 8MiB view.
Exactly one PT_INTERP, length2..4096, offset>=ehsize, full segment in actual view, one terminal NUL and no interior NUL.

ASCII normalized absolute nonvirtual non-parent-traversing PT_INTERP pathname from captured Python header-view remains descriptive only. Existing canonical/regular loader and trusted linkage observations belong to the new guardian build and remain unchanged; they do not authenticate the Python PT_INTERP payload or mapped loader. Python loader full payload/mapped-code proof remains absent.

Python arbitrary-precision offset/table arithmetic retains all existing bounds. No integer narrowing/wrap, clipping a declared length, reconstructing absent bytes or acceptance of headers/PT_INTERP outside the view.
proposed_delta.no_old_constant_or_monkeypatch: No edits to pinned utilities/constants, monkeypatch, alternate interpreter, old request/PID/argv, boolean unlock or runtime fallback.
proposed_delta.payload_scope: The frozen parser checked ELF descriptors/PT_INTERP, never every PT_LOAD/section or entire mapped payload. Restricting its available bytes to an actual prefix is stricter for header/table/path reachability. This does not certify full segments, loading, loader/stdlib/native mappings, runtime ABI or model capability.
proposed_delta.scope_limit: Resolving this particular observer parser size gate does not prove remaining guardian/runtime/loader/readonly package facts or fresh host applicability.
proposed_delta.view_semantics: Actual first min(full_length,8MiB) captured bytes, with no reconstructed header, artificial padding, alternate offsets, second parser or fallback. Header-view SHA identifies that view; existing full interpreter SHA continues to identify the full captured file. Full-body and view SHA values are separate actual machine fields. A change after the view retains view SHA but must change full captured SHA and fail the existing exact request/input drift gate.
